about.title: About
about.description: Methodology, baseline rule and credits of Genshin DPS.
about.methodology: Genshin DPS gathers benchmarks published by the community, such as DPS dummy measurements and simulations. Every number is the DPS of the whole team, the sum of all four characters over the rotation, and follows the source’s methodology: each team page credits the author, describes the method and links to the original post.
about.baseline: The Baseline filter only shows teams where every 5★ character is at C0 and every 5★ weapon is at R1. The exception is what the game gives for free: C1 of the 5★ characters from the To Temper Thyself and Journey Far event, any Traveler constellation and free 5★ weapons, such as the Exaiphanes Blade, at any refinement. 4★ characters and 4★ or 3★ weapons count at any investment.
about.credits: Game names and data come from the genshin-db package. Icons come from Enka.Network.
about.fanContent: Genshin DPS is a fan project, not affiliated with HoYoverse. Genshin Impact, its characters, images and trademarks belong to HoYoverse.
